do.text: Align amounts to the end, with `tabular-nums`, so their digits line up.

dont.text: Don't left-align a column of amounts.

title: Give every drawn cell its text

do.text: When a cell draws a badge or an icon, keep its meaning in text that screen readers hear.

dont.text: Don't leave a drawn cell with no text: a glyph alone says nothing to a screen reader.
